QuestInfo.name: Eliminating King Sage Cat
QuestInfo.1:
When you tell Do Gong about the conversation you had with the King Sage Cat, he's not surprised at how it turned out. You probably won't be getting the antidote crystal from the King Sage Cat without a fight. Eliminate the #rKing Sage Cat#k, who can be found in #b#m250010503##k and #b#m250010504##k, and get the #bantidote crystal#k!

QuestInfo.2: After defeating the King Sage Cat, I grabbed the Antidote Marble and gave it to Do Gong. Fortunately, the marble was legit, and Do Gong seems to have been cured from poisoning. I better make it a habit of not being so gullible against others with suspect motives.

0.0: Hoh... Did you manage to find the antidote...? You weren't able to get one from King Sage Cat...? Isn't that obvious? If he was to give you the antidote that easily, then he wouldn't have poisoned me in the first place... Cough cough!
0.1: Now all you can do is defeat the King Sage Cat and get the antidote! You're strong enough to defeat him... I'll put my faith in you.

no.0: Maybe I was wrong...\r\nYou're my only hope, #h0#. \r\nPlease come back if you change your mind.

1.0: Hmph... (Breathing heavily)... oh, you, you are back... were you able to...oh, so this is the... Antidote Marble...

yes.1: ...phew... Fortunately, the Antidote Marble is real. I have a feeling the King Sage Cat was using the Antidote Marble as a bait for something very sinister. Thank goodness his plan was foiled... hmmm? Why do you have that look on your face?
yes.2: Don't feel sorry. I may have been poisoned, but I'm fully cured now. You were also able to defeat the King Sage Cat once and for all! Isn't that what we all hoped for? He was a thorn in Mu Lung's side for the longest time, but this should keep him quiet for a while now. Thank you so much!

item.0: Hmm...were you not able to obtain the Antidote Marble? You can acquire the #bAntidote Marble#k by defeating the #rKing Sage Cat#k.
